title: Platinum Plus Account: Credit Card APY Bonuses
summary: This document lists credit card APY bonuses available to Platinum Plus Account holders when they also hold eligible Rho-Bank credit cards under the same customer profile. Bonus rates shown: Gold +0.1%, Platinum +0.4%, Diamond +0.6%, Eco +0.05%, Crypto-Cash Back +0.25% (others listed as +0%). Bonuses are automatically applied to Platinum Plus earnings after meeting qualification steps.
